column1: # The founding science corpus: 50 papers, ingested 2026-10-04.
# Numbering is the order they were given in. All 50 have open full text;
# the four that at first looked closed (24, 39, 41 Springer-hosted, 43 a
# PubMed abstract page) all resolved to open versions, which is why this
# file records identifiers rather than the original links — resolve the
# DOI before believing a paper is unreachable.
# Ingesting is not accepting. Every record lands `unreviewed` and is
# therefore NOT retrievable; search_evidence returns accepted records only.
# ---- programming: load, failure proximity, volume, ROM ------------------
# 43 BJSM sleep consensus (10.1136/bjsports-2020-102025) is open access but
# NOT in PMC: bronze OA, published-version PDF at bjsm.bmj.com. It was
# ingested from that PDF with the reference list cut off the tail, which
# this PMC-shaped script does not do. Re-ingesting it needs that handling.
